title: Cusi co-accused in Malampaya case seeks court permission for Japan travel
summary: A co-accused of former energy secretary Alfonso Cusi in the graft case over the sale of Malampaya stake asked the Sandiganbayan to allow him to travel to Japan for a geoscience forum.
